preconditions.description: The number of employees n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of pairs of people who don't like each other m must be between 0 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in dislikes)
preconditions.description: Each pair of disliked employees must be within the range of 1 to n and must be distinct.
The number of salary revisions q must be between 0 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for v in salary_revisions)
preconditions.description: Each salary revision must involve an employee number between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain q + 1 integers representing the number of dangerous triples at the beginning of each day.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value must be a non-negative integer representing the count of dangerous triples.
